# Interview Me Skill for Muse

What you ask for and what you actually want are different things — this skill closes that gap before anything gets built. Muse states its hypothesis about your request with a confidence number, then asks you one question at a time, each with its best guess attached, until it can restate your intent in your own words and you confirm with an explicit yes. Note: the skill insists on a live, responsive user — it's designed for an interactive conversation, not for background or automated runs. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
